mintAuthority.headline: Deposits mint asset-backed shares; a three-of-six Safe controls reward parameters, without arbitrary share minting or an enforced delay.

capSemanticsReview.rationale: The exact immutable StakedFrax deployment only mints shares after transferring legacy FRAX into the vault through deposit or mint. Rewards distribute existing FRAX rather than creating unbacked shares. The parameter Safe may change the reward-rate cap and reassign its own authority, but cannot replace code, withdraw backing arbitrarily or authorize a native share minter. Parent FRAX issuance and reserve exposure remain inherited separately.
